subject.title: fix(ai): safely serialize non-Error stream failures to avoid circular crashes

question: Should this PR be expanded into the canonical provider-wide total error formatter, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107800 own that boundary instead?
rationale: Both branches address the same root cause but choose different scopes, and selecting the permanent package-level formatter and sibling coverage is an ownership decision rather than a safe mechanical repair.

options.title: Unify the formatter boundary
options.body: Choose one branch to implement a total provider-wide formatter with actual Google and OpenAI Completions lifecycle proof, then close the competing branch after the canonical path is viable.

options.title: Keep this patch narrow
options.body: Retain this branch's serializer shape, guard `instanceof` inside the helper, add actual affected-provider lifecycle proof, and track broader sibling hardening separately.

options.title: Prefer the competing PR
options.body: Pause this branch and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107800, but only treat it as canonical after its proof and correctness gates are satisfied.

recommendation.title: Unify the formatter boundary
recommendation.body: Choose one branch to implement a total provider-wide formatter with actual Google and OpenAI Completions lifecycle proof, then close the competing branch after the canonical path is viable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent OpenClaw provider-runtime and shared compatibility work makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the package-level boundary decision.
